title: bouba_sens: A Pre-Registered Cross-Modal Plasticity Benchmark
description:
A pre-registered benchmark measuring three invariants of cross-modal plasticity (B-1 congenital-blindness T1/T2 gap, B-2 informational migration, B-3 perceptive/proprioceptive structural asymmetry) across five synthetic worlds and a 4.5-modal real Studyforrest Phase-2 bridge. Thresholds locked by OSF registration 10.17605/OSF.IO/Q6JYN before the evaluation campaign. Companion to the TMLR submission v0.1.

Central empirical claim (narrow and falsifiable): a frozen PSK mux with hard-binary transducer gating is the minimal architectural configuration that qualitatively reproduces the Amedi 2007 T1/T2 asymmetry on the real biological bridge; every compound tested (soft Gumbel gating, finer tau scans, codebook freeze, phase-transition schedule) was null or harmful.
notes: Built on nerve-wml v1.5.3 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19666405). Reproducible via `bash scripts/reproduce_paper_v01.sh`; byte-identity verification via `scripts/sha256_manifest.py` against `reports/MANIFEST.json`.
